title: Bibi-Khanym Mosque
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi Bibi-Khanym compound exterior:open mapped courtyard,monumental eastern gateway and deep western prayer iwan,paired tall western tiled pylons,smooth turquoise main dome,two ribbed blue side domes,low brick walls and four mapped raised wall piers. Five shared graphs,six merged surface roles,four authored browser levels. Heights and footprints retain current tags;small doorways,ornament,unseen backs and exact damage remain approximate. Named-place location/layout match,not a claimed exact-QID map match. No copied calligraphy,interior reconstruction or courtyard slab. Low wall residuals are cleared in front of the two pavilion iwan mouths;the current raw map courtyard and pavilion controls are preserved unchanged. Exact entry thresholds remain approximate.
